<RuleHeader />

Reports a lambda block that only returns a value the expression form can
return just as well: `x -> { return x + 1; }` is `x -> x + 1`.

The rule is deliberately value-only. A block whose returned expression is
a JLS §14.8 `StatementExpression` — a call, an assignment, an
increment/decrement, or a class instance creation — is left alone: the
block form is value-compatible but not void-compatible (JLS §15.27.2),
while the expression form of a statement expression is _both_ (JLS
§§15.12.2.1, 15.27.3). Rewriting one would widen the lambda's target
type set, which can change overload resolution. Keeping the replacement
outside that production preserves the target set without resolving types.
